summary: Iteration 13 — Multi-category GST split (activity/food/room/clothing/merchandise/other) and super-lenient inquiries/import. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter13_gst_split_and_lenient_import.py with 10 pytest cases: (a) 4-category gst_split package (Games/Dinner/Room stay/T-shirt @ 2000/1200/1500/300) auto-expands into 4 bill lines with correct gst_percent (18/5/12/12) and HSN (999721/996331/996311/6109), gst_breakup has 3 unique rates (5/12/18) with CGST+SGST split (intra-state, IGST=0); (b) merchandise + other both @18% HSN 999799; (c) legacy food_portion+activity_portion continues to auto-split into 2 lines (5% + 18%); (d) inquiries/import headerless xlsx with phone-only rows → name='Unknown'; (e) Hindi header (नाम/मोबाइल) detected; (f) junk header row before real header detected in row 2; (g) float phone 9111100007.0 → '9111100007'; (h) '+91' / '919...' / '+91-...' prefix stripped to last 10 digits; (i) source shortcuts insta/fb/wa/walkin → instagram/facebook/whatsapp/walk-in; (j) import with weird header (no name/phone alias) does NOT return 400 — still imports via cell-scan fallback. Result: 10/10 PASSED in 7.04s. Full regression on prior test_gst_compliance.py: 16/16 PASSED. Frontend Playwright on desktop 1440x900: logged in as admin, verified all requested test IDs on /packages Add dialog (pkg-gst-split-card, pkg-add-split-btn, pkg-autofill-btn, pkg-split-label-N, pkg-split-cat-N, pkg-split-amt-N, pkg-split-sum). Autofill from inclusions='Games, Dinner, Room, T-shirt' + price 5000 creates 4 rows summing to 5000 (equal split, all default 'activity' category). Split-sum badge showed green (emerald class) when sum==price. Saved a package with explicit categories (Games/activity/2000, Dinner/food/1200, Room stay/room/1500, T-shirt/clothing/300) and verified card renders: '· Games ₹2000 @18% · Dinner ₹1200 @5% · Room stay ₹1500 @12% · T-shirt ₹300 @12%'. Generated a bill from that package (bill_id=1fe05a66-...) and on /bills/{id} verified upi-pay-block, upi-qr-img (src = artifact URL), upi-id-btn (text='linearcurrent@axl'), upi-open-app-btn all present. On /bills/{id}/print for pending bill verified upi-pay-block-print + QR + 'Pay via UPI' + linearcurrent@axl all in HTML; after Mark Paid, print block count=0 (hidden). On /visit switched Payment Method to 'UPI (QR)' and verified upi-pay-block-compact appears. Code-review-verified: PublicBook.jsx line 220 imports and renders UpiPayBlock in checkout. Existing packages (Birthday Gold/Silver/Fun Starter/Gold, 12 total) still render normally — regression clean.

issues: React hydration warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' — comes from a shadcn Select rendering <span> inside native <option>. Non-blocking but noisy in console.

'Install Funland App' toast + 'Install manually' modal can overlay bill-generate button in some flows; needed to dismiss via 'Later' in Playwright. Not a bug per se, but sometimes covers the CTA on smaller viewports.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1697 lines — long-standing recommendation to split into routers (auth/games/packages/bills/inquiries/settings) still open. Not blocking.

packages autoFillFromInclusions() defaults ALL rows to category='activity' — a small UX enhancement would be to keyword-map: 'dinner|food|snack|cake' → food, 'room|stay|night' → room, 't-shirt|tshirt|apparel|jersey' → clothing. Optional; spec only required sum==price, which is satisfied.
inquiries/import: assignee_doc lookup uses direct name equality — case-sensitive. Consider case-insensitive match if importers vary casing. Non-critical.
PublicBook UpiPayBlock is rendered unconditionally — good; UpiPayBlock itself returns null when both upi_id & upi_qr_url are missing, so safe on parks that haven't configured UPI.

PrintBill useEffect auto-triggers window.print() 400ms after data load — this can fire before UpiPayBlock's QR has fully loaded from remote CDN in slow-network scenarios; the printed PDF might miss the QR. Consider waiting for image load event before firing print, or preloading via new Image().

PackageIn accepts gst_percent per split line but backend also fills default from category — fine. HSN default map for clothing=6109 is correct for apparel > ₹1000; if a park sells cheaper apparel (<₹1000, 5% GST) there's no override yet — minor edge case.
